selection.candidates: All decodable frames up to 5400; otherwise integer linspace over the complete video
selection.dino: facebook/dinov2-large, FP32 pooler_output, short side 256 bicubic, center crop 224, ImageNet normalization

clustering.representative: global nearest candidate to each centroid

modes.hybrid4_neighbor: Fresh k=4 clustering plus global CLIP maximum and nominal one-second temporal neighbor
modes.hybrid4_top2: Same k=4 context plus highest-scoring unselected CLIP candidates until six total

selection.neighbor_direction: Earlier for before-only wording, later for after-only wording, otherwise higher CLIP score at the two offsets; use other side if unavailable
selection.duplicates: Preserve context, deduplicate, fill by decreasing CLIP score, sort by source-frame index
selection.degenerate_clusters: Fill repeated representatives with temporally distant unselected candidates
selection.answer_leakage: Selectors never read answer choices or labels

sampling.method: Proportional subtype quotas, includes fixed pilot, independent of predictions

evaluation.parser: Initial capital A-E, optionally preceded by opening parenthesis
evaluation.mcnemar: Descriptive only; question independence is not assumed for inference

reproduction_deviations: Released clustering script hardcodes twelve; this study follows the six-frame setting
Greedy decoding instead of inference script's sampling default
Hugging Face conversion of CLIP weights; original-package bitwise parity unverified
Degenerate-cluster fill differs from released uniform fallback
Strict answer parser differs from released heuristic
Published KTV score parity has not been established

direct_cost_benchmark.sampling: Candidate-count midpoint quantiles, one sorted-ID question per video
direct_cost_benchmark.memory_pool: LLaVA, CLIP and DINO resident for every policy

interpretation: No established overall accuracy improvement. Temporal benefit uncertain. Additional CLIP compute makes the hybrid approximately 1.60 times slower in the small direct-cost sample.
